book.name: Taalie
book.title: Ala xa Taalie Ala xa Taalie

content.text: N ma di, n ma wɔyɛnyi ragata i bɔɲɛ kui,
n ma sɛriyɛ xa lu i sondonyi ma.
N ma sɛriyɛ suxu alako i xa simaya sɔtɔ,
n ma xaranyi xa rafan i ma alɔ i ya firinyie.
N ma sɛriyɛ xiri i bɛlɛxɛsolee ra, a sɛbɛ i sondonyi ma.
Lɔnni xa findi i maaginɛ ra,
xaxili fanyi xa findi i bari mixi ra.
N ma sɛriyɛ i ratangama nɛ langoe ma,
e i ratangama nɛ yɛnɛla xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ ma.
Lɔxɔɛ nde, n nu na n ma banxi kui,
n tande matoma wundɛri ra.
N naxa xaxilitare nde to,
sɛgɛtala naxan xa fahaamui mu gbo.
A naxa kira suxu naxan dangima langoe ginɛ xa banxi dɛ ra.
A nu bara a xun ti mɛnni ra.
Nunmare tɛmui nan nu a ra,
kɔɛ nu bara so, kuye nu bara ifɔɔrɔ.
Ginɛ nde naxa sa a ralan,
a maxirixi langoe ginɛ ki,
a nu wama na xɛmɛ madaxufe nɛ.
Ginɛ murutaxi nan a ra,
naxan wɔyɛn xui ite, a mixi matandi.
A ɲɛrɛma taa kui xɛmɛ fenfe ra.
A naxa na xɛmɛ suxu,
a a masunbu, a a fala a bɛ yɛtɛ igboɲa ra,
«N laayidi tongo nɛ Ala bɛ,
n bara na rakamali sɛrɛxɛ ra to.
N minixi i fende na nan ma.
Yakɔsi n bara i to.
Misira sade dugi maɲingixi na n sade ma,
a nun labundɛ xiri fanyi mɔɔli birin na.
Fa be, won xa yɛnɛ raba han gɛɛsɛgɛ,
won xa won waxɔnyi birin naba,
barima n ma xɛmɛ mu na banxi,
a sigaxi biyaasi xɔnkuye.
A bara kɔbiri gbegbe xanin a xun ma,
a mu fama fo yi kike ɲɔn.»
A naxa nɔ na xɛmɛ ra a xa kɔɔta saabui ra,
a naxa nɔ a ra a xa dɛ iɲɔxunyi ra.
Xɛmɛ naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra keren na,
alɔ ninge naxan sigafe ninge faxade,
alɔ xeli naxan a sanyi rasofe yɛlɛ kui,
alɔ xɔni naxan tife gantanyi ma,
han tanbɛ fa a bɔɲɛ sɔxɔ, a faxa,
a mu a kolon a xa simaya danma mɛnni nɛ.
Yakɔsi n ma die, wo wo tuli mati n na,
wo n ma masenyi ramɛ.
I bɔɲɛ naxa i madaxu i xa bira na ginɛ mɔɔli fɔxɔ ra,
i naxa i ɲɛrɛ a xa kira ra,
barima a bara mixi gbegbe faxa,
a bara sɛnbɛmae yati rabira.
A xa banxi findixi faxɛ kira nan na,
mixi goroma aligiyama dɛnnaxɛ ra.
